mathcounts-potw-2026-06-29-01.title: Subtract the orders
mathcounts-potw-2026-06-29-01.body:
Hannah's hot dog and soda cost $5.50 - 1.00 = 4.50$. Latrease's order has one more hot dog: $7.50 - 4.50 = 3.00$.

**Answer: \$3.00**

mathcounts-potw-2026-06-29-02.title: Only the first ten vary
mathcounts-potw-2026-06-29-02.body:
The last five are fixed, so only the other 10 fireworks can be arranged in the first 10 slots: $10! = 3{,}628{,}800$.

**Answer: 3,628,800**

mathcounts-potw-2026-06-29-02.title: Slot by slot
mathcounts-potw-2026-06-29-02.body:
Slot 1 has 10 choices, slot 2 has 9, …, slot 10 has 1, and slots 11–15 have 1 each: $10 \cdot 9 \cdots 1 = 3{,}628{,}800$.

**Answer: 3,628,800**

mathcounts-potw-2026-06-29-03.title: Cups per person
mathcounts-potw-2026-06-29-03.body:
Planned: $42 \div 12 = 3.5$ cups per person. 3 extra guests need $3 \times 3.5 = 10.5$ more cups.

**Answer: 10.5 cups**

mathcounts-potw-2026-06-29-03.title: New total
mathcounts-potw-2026-06-29-03.body:
15 people at 3.5 cups is $52.5$ cups; they have 42, so they need $10.5$ more.

**Answer: 10.5 cups**
